c1-15-001.gate_key: adv_agree | C1 | gap | We need two more chairs: the manager and two of her assistants ___ coming to the meeting tomorrow. (be) |

item.q: We need two more chairs: the manager and two of her assistants ___ coming to the meeting tomorrow. (be)
item.why: With *and*, the subject is plural: *The manager and two of her assistants are coming.* With *together with*, it stays singular: *The manager, together with two of her assistants, is coming.*
item.why_lv: Ar *and* teikuma priekšmets ir daudzskaitlī: *The manager and two of her assistants are coming.* Ar *together with* tas paliek vienskaitlī: *The manager, together with two of her assistants, is coming.*

item.q: Start with *So loud*: The music was so loud that we couldn't hear each other.
item.why: *So* + adjective at the start, then *be* before the subject: *So loud was the music that…*
item.why_lv: *So* + īpašības vārds sākumā, tad *be* pirms teikuma priekšmeta: *So loud was the music that*…
answers: So loud was the music that we couldn't hear each other.
So loud was the music that we could not hear each other.

c1-15-003.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | text | Join the two sentences: make the second one an *-ing* form. The river burst its banks. It flooded the streets near the station. |

accepted: The river burst its banks, flooding the streets near the station.

item.q: Join the two sentences: make the second one an *-ing* form. The river burst its banks. It flooded the streets near the station.
item.why: An *-ing* clause after the main clause for its direct result: *…, flooding the streets near the station.*
item.why_lv: *-ing* daļa aiz galvenā teikuma tiešam rezultātam: …, *flooding the streets near the station*.
answers: The river burst its banks, flooding the streets near the station.

c1-15-004.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | gap | I'm always losing receipts. I wish I ___ them all in one folder, but I never do. (keep) |

item.q: I'm always losing receipts. I wish I ___ them all in one folder, but I never do. (keep)
item.why: A wish about a present habit: *I wish* + past simple, *I wish I kept them in one folder*. About one moment in the past: *I wish I had kept the receipt*.
item.why_lv: Vēlēšanās par ieradumu tagad: *I wish* + Past Simple, *I wish I kept them in one folder.* Par vienu brīdi pagātnē: *I wish I had kept the receipt.*
